evidence.name: Screen field: Size of the field text
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Size of the field text" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Size of the field text
sections.description: Sets how large the text in the field appears, from 0 to 50 points (default 15). Keep it around 15-17 points so answers are comfortable to read on a phone. Text that's too small is hard to read on mobile, where most ad traffic lands, and can quietly drag down completion.
